protocol: Each final occurrence is unique(expert,expert_local_row), with explicit originalsource. Complete coverage is checked.
PerexactDomain(kind,owner,QP) within epoch, records are supplied in strict gapless submission sequence1..N. No finalrow sorting and no QP frontier merge.

Fullrowbyte retirement notifications may arrive out of order; completed set advances frontier only across contiguous prefix. Duplicate sameepoch notifications are idempotent; wrong/old/future/reclaimed epoch rejected.
Tile dependency stores maxseq per actual writerdomain, for actualexpert-local rows only. Empty expert/tailpadding has no waittarget.
Xe is persistent: allwrites complete, trainingbackward done and every predeclared primaryreadlease retired before next_epoch. ABA oldnotices cannot affect next invocation.
source_alignment: No contradiction found with reviewed finalwrite paths. Domains/retirement points must correspond to true ordered completion, not SIMT WQE build/doorbell/Native return. Primary arrival only retires its own occurrence; secondary finalrows have independent writers.
integration_gaps: Input is hand-normalized records; no realNotify/parser/expert-source count extraction implemented.
Need exact finalwriter classification and record->physicalQP/localwriter mapping from resolvedroutes/pairtable/forwardrecords; source counts alone are insufficient.
A physical orderedQP shared by multiple producers must have a unified actual submissionseq; cannot invent independent perthread frontiers or merge distinctQPs.

Each fullrowbyte notification is assumed authoritative. SDK/device visibility, remote ordering, release/acquire, CQE coverage and sourceDMA-reader lifetime must be proved by a separate nativeprotocol.
Primary leases are predeclared reader-lifetime obligations; model does not simulate device read operations, barriers, cancellation or hidden additional readers.
PersistentXe retains actual memory until backward and readers retire; no ringbuffer or overwrite optimization modeled.
